messages:
Alex: Heads-up — weʼre aiming to roll out the 'data-at-rest playbook' this Thurs. Need quick sign-off on RBAC delta, KMS integration for S3/DB backups, and snapshot restore runbook. Who can review?
Maria: I can take RBAC + backup restore steps. Quick Q: are we planning customer CMKs for Private customers or just account-level CMKs initially? :thinking_face:
Alex: Starting with account-level CMKs for the first phase. Customer-provided CMKs is phase 2 (on-prem/VPC). Reason: key escrow and HSM onboarding complexity.
Jonathan: For audit logging — are we pushing logs to the centralized audit pipeline (kinesis -> lake) or keeping a separate S3 bucket per account? Need to confirm retention & immutability requirements.
Priya: Also flagging vuln triage: CVE-2024-xxxxx affects snapshot tooling (libsnap). Ticket #4321 has initial triage, patch is available but needs validation in staging restore.
Maria: Ack. For RBAC, propose adding two new roles: `backup-operator` (can create/restore snapshots, read-only access to backup metadata) and `kms-admin-lite` (rotate but not delete CMKs). Anyone object?
Jonathan: thumbs-up from infra. One note: backup-operator must be restricted by resource tag (env:prod) to avoid cross-env restores. Can we add that constraint to the playbook?
Alex: Yes — included constraint in playbook snippet:
```yaml
roles:
  - name: backup-operator
    perms: [snapshots:create, snapshots:restore, backups:read]
    resource_selector: tag.env == 'prod'
```
Maria: Nice. For restore validation steps Iʼll add a canary checklist: restore to isolated VPC, run schema and rowcount validation, smoke test ML jobs, compare checksums.
sec-bot: Automated check: KMS keys for `prod-db` found with rotation disabled. (resource=arn:aws:kms:..:prod-db). Please enable key rotation or provide justification.
Priya: Iʼll pick up the KMS rotation fixes. Also will validate libsnap patch in staging restore path. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jonathan: About audit retention: SOC2 wants 1 year hot + 4 years archived. We currently have 180d. Ops to update retention policy and set S3 Object Lock in compliance buckets.
Alex: Good catch. Action items: Maria -> add canary + restore checklist; Priya -> patch + KMS rotation; Jonathan -> retention + S3 Object Lock; Alex -> update playbook doc and coordinate rollout window Thurs 02:00-05:00 PST (low traffic).
Maria: :thumbsup: Iʼll post the playbook PR once checklist is in.
Priya: :eyes: will update ticket #4321 with staging results.
Jonathan: Will schedule a short runbook drill Fri to practice restores with the new RBAC.
Alex: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD today Iʼll merge and schedule the rollout.
Maria: No objections from me.
Priya: All good.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: rollout window Thu 02:00-05:00 PST. Type `confirm` in thread to acknowledge.
Alex: confirm
Maria: confirm
Jonathan: confirm
Priya: confirm
